titulo.en: How it is cooked, how it tastes

texto.en:
**Cooking and agreement.** The cooking method follows the food name: **pescado a la plancha**. Adjectives agree with the food: **verduras crudas**, **carne poco hecha** or **muy hecha**. **Frito** and **hervido** are also used as food descriptions.

**Taste.** When you describe how a dish tastes now, **estar** is common: **Pruebo el marisco: está soso.** **Ser** can describe a more general characteristic. The choice depends on meaning and context. Other taste words include **salado**, **dulce**, **amargo** and **picante**.

**Sentar bien / mal** works like **gustar**: the food is the subject and the person is marked by a pronoun: **el marisco me sienta mal**; **las legumbres te sientan bien**. The verb agrees with the food.

**Eating patterns.** A Mediterranean-style pattern often includes **fruta**, **verdura**, **legumbres**, **pescado** and **aceite de oliva**. Some descriptions limit **carne roja** and **embutido**, but eating patterns and needs vary.

A balanced, varied diet can take many forms. A general recommendation is that we eat a variety of foods and moderate salt. Nutrition words: **vitaminas**, **proteínas**, **fibra**, **hierro**, **calorías**. For general statements about food groups, Spanish often uses the definite article: **la fruta**, **el aceite de oliva**. Eating slowly and in company are also part of some food traditions.

frases.es: La dieta mediterránea suele describirse como un patrón de alimentación saludable, aunque no es un menú único ni igual para todo el mundo.
frases.en: The Mediterranean diet is often described as a healthy eating pattern, though it is not one fixed menu that suits everyone.

aunque no es un menú único ni igual para todo el mundo

frases.en: It often includes fruit, vegetables, pulses, fish and olive oil.
analisis: fruta, verdura, legumbres, pescado y aceite de oliva

frases.es: Las lentejas y los garbanzos contienen proteínas y fibra.
frases.en: Lentils and chickpeas contain protein and fibre.

frases.es: Algunas descripciones del patrón mediterráneo aconsejan moderar la carne roja y el embutido, aunque las prácticas y necesidades varían.
frases.en: Some descriptions of the Mediterranean pattern recommend moderating red and processed meats, although practices and needs vary.
analisis: moderar la carne roja y el embutido

frases.es: La recomendación general es que comamos alimentos variados y moderemos la sal; las necesidades cambian de una persona a otra.
frases.en: The general recommendation is to eat a variety of foods and moderate salt; needs vary from person to person.
analisis: cambian de una persona a otra

frases.es: Pero no solo importa lo que se come: también se valora comer despacio y en compañía en algunas tradiciones.
frases.en: But what people eat is not the only thing that matters: some traditions also value eating slowly and with others.

texto.en:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (100–120 words).** Write about your diet: what you eat, what you should eat more or less of, and why.

**Speak (about 2 minutes).** Give your opinion aloud on fast food, vegetarian diets or eating at set times.
